response.original_title: [{Upgrades→Help}] Does Qantas offer last minute upgrades?
response.overview: Does Qantas offer last minute upgrades? Yes, Qantas offers last minute +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK) upgrades up until the boarding gate through their Domestic On Departure Upgrade Rewards and Bid Now programs. Eligible frequent flyers can ✆ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK) request immediate point upgrades via the mobile app starting three hours prior to scheduled departure times ☏ +61-1800-290-956 (AUS) OR +1-888-315-9962 (US) OR +44-800-652-9734 (UK).
